page.title: Hamlet (prince)
page.meta_description: Hamlet is the student-prince of the play that bears his name, son of the dead king, nephew of Claudius, and the voice of the 'To be or not to be' soliloquy.…
page.content:
Prince of Denmark who delays, feigns madness, and kills Claudius at the last.

How Hamlet (prince) connects

  • Work: Hamlet — The prince is the title figure of Hamlet.
  • Character: Claudius — Hamlet's revenge is aimed at King Claudius.
  • Character: Ophelia — Hamlet's rejection of Ophelia precedes her madness and death.

What is Hamlet (prince)?

Hamlet is the student-prince of the play that bears his name, son of the dead king, nephew of Claudius, and the voice of the 'To be or not to be' soliloquy.

Key threads lead to Hamlet, Claudius and Ophelia.
